Lewis Hamilton won the most races at Silverstone between 2000 and 2025, with 9 wins: 2008, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2024.

The nearest rivals had 2 each (Schumacher, Alonso, Webber, Vettel and Verstappen), so Hamilton's lead holds whether or not the 2020 70th Anniversary Grand Prix is counted.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
